beats.name: hook
beats.said: Two scratch cards: one winner, one loser, and a way to tell which without scratching.
beats.shown: Hero at a desk lays two cards down, a golden glow lights one, then a zoom into a card and a number grid.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: A fired man spends five dollars on two cards, wins his money back, but turns suspicious.
beats.shown: Shopfront, shop counter, close-up of the card with a badge, then the hero at his desk with a flat skeptical look.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: He wonders how the lottery knows winners, then spends his severance on a huge stack and stares.
beats.shown: Card close-up, tilt down to a print factory with a winners counter, the shop with flying cards, an apartment floor of cards.

beats.name: explainer
beats.said: Card numbers mostly repeat; where three singletons line up in a row, the card wins.
beats.shown: Close-ups of a number grid on cards, numbers colour-coded, singletons glow gold and a pencil strikes a row.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: He has cracked the lottery and could clean out every gas station in the state.
beats.shown: Hero beaming with a card in the apartment of cards, then a state map with gas-station pins and a red circle.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: He calls the lottery, is told it's impossible, and brings a box of unscratched cards to the office.
beats.shown: Phone close-up, headset operator speaking and unconvinced, then hero with box at the operator's desk.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: He sorts unscratched cards into winners and losers and gets ninety right.
beats.shown: Hero with a desk-stuff box, operator checks cards against a row of cards on the desk.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: By week's end the game is pulled from every store.
beats.shown: Shop queue, game closed sign on the machine, hero walks in carrying the box. Stops on the image.

hook.first_frame: Hero stands behind a wooden desk in a green office with a lamp and red phone, holding a scratch card in each outstretched hand, scowling at the camera.
hook.first_3s: Cards drop to the desk and spread; the camera pushes in then tilts to a tighter shot; a golden glow with sparkles hits the left card and the hero's face goes bright with wide eyes.
hook.first_frame_subject: protagonist posing with the key prop
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title promises he spotted winners by looking; the first line sets up two cards to look at, which is the same promise as a demo.

story.real_fact_core: Printed number grids on scratch cards leak winners: singletons forming a row mark a winner, so cards can be sorted without scratching.
story.protagonist: Fired office worker in a yellow vest, tie and ID badge, brown fringe
story.authority_or_antagonist: Lottery office operator in a headset who dismisses him; later the lottery stops the game

tone.humour: Dry and sarcastic; mock-sensible lines about a drastic spending choice; deadpan faces and blank stares carry the jokes.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Heavy: the narration sells reckless acts as what any sane person would do, while the hero's expression stays flat.
tone.dialogue_style: Almost all narration; one line of reported speech from the operator, short and flat.

characters.head: Large round white head, thick dark outline
characters.eyes: Small black ovals with heavy lids and thick brows; switches to ringed wide pupils when excited
characters.mouth: Tiny line or small shape; wide toothy grin in happy shots
characters.body_and_clothes: Bean-shaped yellow-orange vest body, blue and red striped tie, ID badge on lanyard
characters.limbs: Thin dark noodle arms and legs, no hands

characters.head: White round head, outline

characters.eyes: Half-lidded flat eyes and heavy brows
characters.mouth: Small dark oval shape that changes while speaking

character_style.outline: Thick dark outline, uniform weight, slightly purple-black; same weight on props and environments.
character_style.shading: Flat fills with soft gradient and rim glow from the set lighting; light tints on the faces from lamps.
character_style.consistency_between_shots: High: same face shapes, vest and colours across all shots; scale varies with camera.

animation.body_motion: Cut-out style: head and body slide and tilt as whole shapes; limbs bend as loops; the camera does most of the work with push-ins and tilts.
animation.eyes_and_blinks: Eyes are swapped between a few drawn states (squint, wide ring, half-lid); no clear blinks seen in the idle hold.
animation.idle_motion: Faint camera drift; hero stays almost still; small sparkles or glow pulses; lamp glow stays steady.
animation.squash_and_stretch: Little; the head shifts slightly while a card or a badge drops with bounce; mostly rigid cut-out shapes.

generation_evidence.observation: In-world numerals and barcode stay sharp across the whole shot with a solid, repeating grid; colour-coding changes cleanly in place.
Card sheets, machine and the winners counter keep consistent perspective through a 2 s tilt, and the text stays legible.
The operator's face changes between a few discrete mouth shapes and the same head shape appears in every frame; the face is a rigid cut-out.
Hero's eye states swap between distinct drawn shapes (wide ring eyes, half-lid) instead of morphing.
Cards fall to the desk with a faint motion trail and drop marks; hero stays crisp.
Queue extras and signs are repeated identical assets across the final shot; the sign reads GAME CLOSED cleanly.
